In the initial problem, a late obstacle (the 9!) can lead an early greedy decision based on the cost to lead to a bad path. The Values contain the FUTURE!!!! So we can go greedy on them, since they already contain info

Dynamic Programming can
be seen to start with posing a
Problem, its subproblems,
Subsub Problems…. Then solving the big problem by soloving the subproblems, which you can do by solving the subsubproblems…. Till you get to a point, where the problems are trivial, and now we can go back and solve the bigger problems. How?
Dynamic Programming:

A diagram of a complex math system

Description automatically generated with medium confidence

By propagating Values from each stage to the earlier  stage by using Bellman’s idea:
The Value at one state is the Min of a set of numbers, each of which is the sum of the cost to one of the next states and the value at that state!
